document.title: The UNJSPF Digital Identity Solution (DCE Flyer)
document.revision: UNJSPF Flyer: The UNJSPF Digital Identity Solution

chunks.heading: Overview of the UNJSPF Digital Identity Solution
chunks.text: Since its launch in 2021, UNJSPF has revolutionized the proof-of-life process of its retirees and beneficiaries with a Digital Identity solution. It leverages cutting-edge technologies to provide a secure, efficient, and user-friendly way to verify life status, ensuring continuous benefit payments, and solving the inefficiencies and potential fraud risks of the legacy paper-based and postal mailing certification process.

chunks.heading: Value proposition for users
chunks.text: Convenience: complete the process from the comfort of home. Speed: receive immediate confirmation upon submission. Accessibility: available to both retirees and active staff. Security: utilizes biometric facial recognition and blockchain technology.

chunks.heading: Enrollment process (summary)
chunks.text: 1. Download the app: available on Apple App Store and Google Play. 2. Request an invitation code: sent by the Fund to eligible individuals. 3. Scan ID and face: use biometric facial recognition. 4. Video call confirmation: a quick call to verify identity. 5. Validate and issue: receive your DCE.

chunks.heading: Technological backbone
chunks.text: Blockchain: an open-source platform that ensures a tamper-proof and independently auditable ledger of all transactions. Biometrics: facial recognition for identity verification. Artificial Intelligence: supports authentication and detects/prevents potential fraud. Geolocation: validates physical location when necessary.

chunks.heading: Achievements and recognition
chunks.text: ISO27001 Certification for information security management. ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Certification for responsible and ethical use of Artificial Intelligence. UN Secretary-General Award for innovation and sustainability. Government Blockchain Association Award for social impact. Featured in a Gartner case study on public sector digital transformation.

chunks.heading: Impact and benefits
chunks.text: Environmental: reduces paper usage and postal services. Efficiency: streamlines the proof-of-life process. Security: enhances data protection and fraud prevention. Inclusivity: addresses the digital divide with a kiosk version for those without devices.

chunks.heading: Supporting Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
chunks.text: The DCE solution supports SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-Being), SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth), SDG 16.9 (Legal Identity), and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals).

chunks.heading: Contact information
chunks.text: For more information or support, visit the UNJSPF Digital Certificate of Entitlement web page or contact the DCE team at dce@unjspf.org.
